k1.author: curator-C
k1.quote: svc.apply(app) submits an application. Application fields: id, age, income, employment (employed or self_employed), requested_limit.
k1.text: svc.apply(app) submits a Calloway application and returns a dict. Application fields: id, age, income, employment (employed or self_employed), requested_limit.

k2.author: curator-C
k2.quote: svc.apply now returns {"api_version": 2, "result": {"outcome": "approved" | "declined" | "manual_review", "credit_limit": <int>}}. The v1 fields `decision` and `limit` are removed. outcome manual_review replaces refer
k2.text: Calloway is now on API v2 (current): svc.apply returns {"api_version": 2, "result": {"outcome": "approved"|"declined"|"manual_review", "credit_limit": <int>}}. The v1 fields `decision` and `limit` are removed. outcome manual_review replaces refer.

k3.author: curator-C
k3.quote: outcome manual_review replaces refer and is handled as in spec section 3.
k3.text: handle(app, svc) returns {action, limit} using the v2 response result.outcome/result.credit_limit. outcome approved -> action issue with credit_limit; declined -> action decline with limit 0; manual_review -> action queue_review with limit 0 (manual_review is not a decline; it goes to the manual review queue, handled as per spec section 3).

k4.author: curator-C
k4.quote: For every partner in the network, whatever the partner decided, an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 4000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
k4.text: Network referral rule: for every partner in the network, an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 4000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued — it overrides an approval. A decline stays a decline.
